latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of image-to-sketch-openapi-skill:

- Converts photos into rough pencil sketches using the WeShop OpenAPI.
- Requires a WESHOP_API_KEY for authentication; users are instructed to keep keys secure.
- Supports uploading local images to generate a reusable URL.
- Main endpoint: POST /openapi/agent/runs; results are polled via GET /openapi/agent/runs/{executionId}.
- Custom sketch styles and batch generation are supported via optional parameters.
